assertions: Every provider request contains one target and the exact members of one bounded Phase 4 temporal context window.
Phase 4 corpus, context bundle, context window, text-view, source-interval, provider, model, policy, and configuration lineage is retained.
Multiple structured provider proposals normalize into separate immutable observations.
Provider evidence spans must reproduce exact target text offsets.
Identified utterance targets and alternatives are confined to the supplied bounded context.
Provider output remains non-authoritative until a later consolidation stage.
Provider-native and unavailable confidence origins remain explicit and uncalibrated.
Raw structured output is retained or hash-addressed through a required digest.
A retryable timeout retries only within policy and does not duplicate normalized observations.
Malformed spans become typed validation failures rather than evidence.
An unavailable provider produces a typed warning and no forced classification.
Persisted provider runs reload and validate without provider reinvocation.
Provider output destinations cannot overlap Phase 4 utterance or context evidence.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, and list provider observations and failures.
limitations: The controlled provider qualifies boundary and normalization mechanics, not natural-conversation classification accuracy.
No production discourse model is selected or qualified.
Provider confidence is not comparable across providers without calibration.
